remarks: Spacious 3-Bedroom Condo in the heart of downtown Stamford!  Welcome to one of the largest units in this sought-after complex-where you can walk to everything! Enjoy vibrant city living in a full-service, 24/7 doorman building that offers exceptional amenities, including an in-ground outdoor pool, sauna, gym, library, beautifully landscaped gardens, & welcoming common areas.  This bright & airy 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom residence is located on the second floor of a well-maintained elevator building. Recently refreshed with crown molding, updated flooring, & fresh paint throughout, the home combines modern upgrades with timeless charm.  The expansive living and dining area features floor-to-ceiling windows that open to a screened-in porch-perfect for relaxing and enjoying refreshing city views. The kitchen is outfitted with brand-new stainless steel appliances: stove, dishwasher, and microwave.  The spacious primary suite offers newer cork flooring, a large walk-in closet, and an en-suite bathroom with a walk-in shower. On the opposite side of the unit, you'll find a newly installed in-unit washer/dryer, a linen closet, a full bathroom with tub and shower, & 2 additional well-sized bedrooms.  Additional highlights include: 2 underground parking spaces, Bonus storage room, 4x4 storage locker in the basement, Only utilities to pay: electric & cable. Sorry, absolutely no pets allowed.
